newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy household confidence index falls in February.
newsitem.headline: Italy household confidence index falls in February.

text.p: Confidence in the economy among Italian households slipped in February, economic research institute Isco said in its latest survey.
Isco's February confidence index (1980=100) fell to 109.0 from 109.9 in January, but remained above February 1996's 107.2.
Isco said pessimism over job prospects had increased but there were hopes of a further easing on the price front.

Households thought the current situation was generally favourable for making short-term purchases but over the next 12 months, families were less inclined to spend on durable goods, a house or new car.
